name: Chain of Custody & Ownership Verification
description: Verify asset serial number, custodian custody release form, and de-registration from enterprise MDM/Active Directory.
standardReference: ISO 27001 Annex A.8.10 / NIST CSF PR.DS-3

name: Authorized Executive & Security Approval
description: Formal sign-off by IT Manager and Information Security Officer prior to sanitization initiation.

name: Certified Sanitization Standard Execution
description: All logical media must undergo NIST 800-88 Purge/Clear or Cryptographic Erasure with zero raw sector residual data.

name: Independent Sanitization Verification
description: Zero-fill sector readback or hex verification performed by a certified technician distinct from the wiping initiator.

name: Tamper-Evident Destruction Certificate
description: Cryptographically signed Certificate of Sanitization with SHA-256 hash containing drive serial, sector count, and timestamp.

name: R2v3 / e-Stewards Environmental Recycling Partner
description: Post-sanitization physical recycling must route to a certified R2v3 or e-Stewards compliant down-stream recycler.
standardReference: EPA IT Asset Lifecycle / R2v3 Standard

name: Seven-Year Immutable Audit Record Retention
description: All sanitization logs, technician signatures, and disposal approvals must be retained in tamper-proof storage.
